title: Code and derived results for: Testing composition rules on a graded association graph: a temporally held-out case study of depressive symptoms in NHANES
description: Analysis pipeline and derived results (relation matrices, edge lists, null-model, bootstrap and t-norm inference results, clinical review form) for a fuzzy relation graph of nine PHQ-9 symptoms and 15 correlates built from NHANES 2007–2018. NHANES source files are public and are downloaded by download_nhanes.py; checksums of the files used are in raw/MANIFEST.md5. Versions 1.1.0 and 1.2.0 add the analyses of the review rounds: predictors without paths, parametric t-norms, scale transformations, withheld relation blocks with cross-validated completion rank, simulations matched to the data's noise and scale, a strength-preserving null and the literature-search records; and, in 1.2.0, RQ3 with the periods swapped, on PSU-split halves of 2013–2018, with binary PHQ-9 items and under every sensitivity setting. Version 1.3.0 adds the analyses of the sixth review: regularised and logit soft-impute, NMF, prevalence-and-block regression, Katz, common-neighbour, Adamic–Adar, resource-allocation and personalised-PageRank indices, a learned path model, within-block and per-source evaluation (NDCG@5), concept-jackknife intervals, calibration fitted on measured pairs in the withheld design, random masking and cold start, age–sex standardised and signed relations, and a respondent-level simulation of chained versus latent-factor generation.
